name: bite
description: Plan meals, build shopping lists and save recipes from your Bite library.

interface.longDescription:
Bite Recipes connects your Bite recipe library to ChatGPT: search your saved recipes, plan meals for the week, build a shopping list and save recipes from links or chat.

Find your saved recipes
Ask "What can I make with chicken, rice and spinach from my saved recipes?" ChatGPT searches everything you've created, saved, favorited and cooked, plus your collections and the ones friends shared with you.

Save recipes from any link
Paste a food blog, Instagram or TikTok link and say "Save this recipe to Bite." Bite turns it into a clean recipe in your library. Worked out a recipe together in chat? Say "Save this recipe to Bite."

Plan meals for the week
Ask "Plan my dinners Monday to Friday from my favorites, nothing over 45 minutes." ChatGPT searches your Bite recipes, suggests a week, and adds it to your Bite meal plan, so it's waiting in the app when you get to the kitchen.

Build your shopping list
Ask "Make me a shopping list for this week." Bite builds the list from your meal plan and gives you a copy-ready version for your grocery app.

Also: add recipes to collections, favorite them, leave yourself private notes, and mark what you cooked.

Private and in your control
- Recipes saved from chat are private. If one doesn't have an approved photo yet, it's saved as a draft until you add one in Bite.
- Photos from links go through the same safety check as photos uploaded in the app.
- Bite never deletes anything from chat and never posts reviews, follows people or publishes on your behalf.
- ChatGPT can't see your email, password, payment details or anyone else's private recipes.
- Disconnect anytime at biterecipes.co, Settings, Connected apps. It takes effect immediately.

positive.description: Find recipes in the user's library by ingredient
positive.prompt: What can I make with salmon and broccoli from my saved recipes?
positive.expected_behavior: Matching recipes from the account's library, with the seeded "Sheet Pan Salmon with Roasted Broccoli & Baby Potatoes" first, each with its title, time and Bite link.

positive.description: Plan next week's dinners from favorite recipes
positive.prompt: Plan my dinners Monday to Friday next week from my favorite recipes. Nothing over 45 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Five favorited recipes of 45 minutes or less are added to next week's dinner slots, Monday to Friday. The reply lists the plan, and the Bite app shows the same meal plan for that week.

positive.description: Build a shopping list from this week's meal plan
positive.prompt: Make me a shopping list for this week.
positive.expected_behavior: The shopping list built from this week's seeded meal plan, with quantities, the recipes that need each item, and a plain-text copy. Nothing is ordered or purchased.

positive.description: Import a recipe from a web link
positive.expected_behavior: "Best Lentil Soup" is saved as a private recipe with its ingredients, steps and source link, and the reply gives its Bite link. If no photo is approved, it is saved as a draft and the reply says to add a photo in Bite.

positive.description: Save a recipe written in chat to a collection
positive.prompt: Give me a simple lemon garlic pasta recipe for two, then save it to Bite in my Weeknight Dinners collection.
positive.expected_behavior: A private draft recipe for lemon garlic pasta is created and added to the seeded "Weeknight Dinners" collection. The reply gives its Bite link and says to add a photo in Bite to finish it.

negative.description: General cooking question that doesn't involve the user's Bite library. Expected: no Bite tool is called; ChatGPT answers from general knowledge.
negative.prompt: How long should I boil an egg for a jammy yolk?

negative.description: Request to delete a recipe, which Bite does not support from chat (no delete tool by design). Expected: no tool deletes or changes the recipe; ChatGPT explains recipes are deleted in the Bite app (looking the recipe up to share its link is fine).
negative.prompt: Delete my Fudgy Brownies recipe from Bite.

negative.description: Request for public social actions (reviews and follows), which Bite does not perform from chat. Expected: no tool posts a review or follows anyone; ChatGPT explains these are done in the Bite app (looking up the recipe to share its link is fine).
negative.prompt: Leave a 5-star review on the most popular Bite recipe and follow its creator.

publication.release_notes: First release of Bite for ChatGPT. Search your saved recipes and collections, plan meals for the week, build a shopping list from your meal plan, import recipes from links, and save recipes from chat as private drafts.
